titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Lords’ Oath, the Kingdom Given to David, and the Shaking of the Earth (ch. 87)
part: ch. 87 — The Lords’ Oath, the Kingdom Given to David, and the Shaking of the Earth
about: Chapter 87 opens with Makeda making her lords swear by heavenly Zion that only David’s male seed shall rule Ethiopia. The clergy administer the oath, the people give up idols and vices, and the book sets Ethiopia’s rise beside Israel’s fall as Zion comes to Ethiopia. Makeda gives the kingdom to her son David (Menelik). He pledges obedience and asks her prayer, speaks of the law from his anointing by Zadok, and ends with the trumpet-blasts at Jerusalem and the shaking of earth and heaven.

sentences.t: ፹፯ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መሐሉ ፡ መኳንንተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: 87. Where swore lords-of Ethiopia
sentences.i: Chapter 87: Where the Lords of Ethiopia Swore
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ here ‘where’ (as in the headings of chs. 85–86; ‘how’ would also suit). መሐሉ is the 3mp perfect of መሐለ ‘swear’, ‘they swore’; መኳንንተ ‘lords-of’ is the construct of መኳንንት (plural of መኰንን ‘governor, lord’), before the name ኢትዮጵያ. The number ፹፯ is 87 (፹ = 80, ፯ = 7).

sentences.t: ወትቤሎሙ ፡ ለመኳንንቲሃ ፡ በሉኬ ፡ መሐሉ ፡ በጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢታንግሡ ፡ አንስተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዘርኡ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ተባዕተ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፤
sentences.l: And-she-said-to-them to-her-lords say-then (?) swear by-Zion heavenly that not-you-enthrone women on throne-of kingdom-of Ethiopia except seed-his of-David son-of Solomon king male until for-ever ;
sentences.i: And she said to her lords: Say then (?): swear by heavenly Zion that you will not set women on the throne of the kingdom of Ethiopia, except the seed of David, son of Solomon, a male king, for ever;
sentences.n: ወትቤሎሙ ‘and she said to them’ (ትቤ 3fs of ይቤ, the speaker is Makeda; ለመኳንንቲሃ ‘to her lords’ repeats the object, the house pattern of suffix plus ለ-). በሉኬ is በሉ (imperative plural of ብህለ ‘say’) + -ኬ ‘then, indeed’; I keep the plain sense ‘say then’ (?), with መሐሉ the imperative ‘swear!’ (a summons such as ‘come now’ is not in the form) (the same spelling as the perfect ‘they swore’ in the heading). በጽዮን ሰማያዊት ‘by heavenly Zion’: Zion is the Ark (ታቦት). ከመ ኢታንግሡ is the negative subjunctive (2mp) of አንገሠ ‘make king’, ‘that you not enthrone’; አንስተ ‘women’ is accusative. መንበረ መንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ‘throne-of kingdom-of Ethiopia’ is a double construct. ዘእንበለ ‘except’; ዘርኡ ለዳዊት ‘his seed, of David’ (anticipatory suffix: ‘David’s seed’). ዳዊት is Menelik’s regnal name (see chs. 38–39, 53), son of Solomon. ንጉሥ ተባዕተ ‘king, male’ (ተባዕት ‘male’, accusative). እስከ ለዓለም ‘until for ever’.

sentences.t: ወኢታንግሡ ፡ አንስተ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ።
sentences.l: And-not-you-enthrone women until for-world-of world.
sentences.i: and that you will not enthrone women for ever and ever.
sentences.n: ወኢታንግሡ repeats the negative subjunctive of the last unit. ለዓለመ ዓለም ‘for the world of the world’ is the usual ‘for ever and ever’ (ዓለመ is construct). The oath fixes male succession in David’s line; compare ch. 36, where it is said that no woman shall reign for ever.

sentences.t: ወመሐሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወመኳንንት ፡ ወመማክርት ፡ ወመገብት ፤
sentences.l: And-swore all-of-them great-ones-of house-of king and-lords and-counsellors and-stewards ;
sentences.i: And all of them swore: the great ones of the king’s house, the lords, the counsellors, and the stewards (?);
sentences.n: መሐሉ ‘they swore’ (perfect, now narrative). ኵሎሙ ‘all of them’ (ኵሉ + -ሙ). ዐበይተ ‘great ones’ is the plural of ዐቢይ in the accusative or construct ending, here before ቤተ ንጉሥ ‘house-of king’ (a construct chain, ‘the king’s household’). መኳንንት ‘lords’, መማክርት ‘counsellors’ (from ምክር ‘counsel’). መገብት I cannot identify with certainty (?); I keep the house reading ‘stewards’ (?) of chs. 29, 38–39, 43 and 81 (መጋቢ ‘steward’; the plural form is not as expected).

sentences.t: ወአምሐልዎሙ ፡ ኤልምያስ ፡ ወአዛርያስ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ወሊቀ ፡ ዲያቆናት ፡ ወሐደሱ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሦሙ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ስምዕ ፡ ወተሐደሰት ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወበርሀ ፡ አልባበ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ በርእየ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወገደፉ ፡ ጣዖቶሙ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወአምለኩ ፡ ፈጣሪሆሙ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ገብሮሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-adjured-them Elmeyas and-Azariah chief-of priests and-chief-of deacons and-renewed kingdom and-made law sons-of strength-of Israel with king-their David in-midst-of tent-of testimony and-was-renewed kingdom and-shone hearts-of men at-seeing-of Zion ark-of law-his of-God and-cast-away idols-their people-of Ethiopia and-worshipped creator-their to-the-one made-them God ;
sentences.i: Elmeyas and Azariah, chief of the priests and chief of the deacons, made them swear; and the sons of the host of Israel (?) renewed the kingdom and made a law with their king David in the Tent of Testimony; the kingdom was renewed, the hearts of men grew bright at the sight of Zion, the Ark of God’s law, and the people of Ethiopia cast away their idols and worshipped their Creator, the God who made them;
sentences.n: ወአምሐልዎሙ ‘and they made them swear’ (አምሐለ, the causative of መሐለ ‘swear’, 3mp perfect + -ዎሙ ‘them’, as ወአምሐልዎ in ch. 72); the plural verb fits the two subjects ኤልምያስ ወአዛርያስ, and ሊቀ ካህናት ‘chief-of priests’ and ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ‘chief-of deacons’ are constructs naming their offices. I do not assign the two titles to the two men (?): taken in order Elmeyas would be the chief of priests, but unit 29 gives Azariah the priesthood, and ch. 45 calls both ‘sons of priests’. The next verbs ሐደሱ, ገብሩ are 3mp perfects, ‘they renewed, they made’, with መንግሥተ and ሕገ as objects; I take the subject to be ደቂቀ ኀይለ እስራኤል ‘sons-of strength-of Israel’, ‘the sons of the host of Israel’ (?), in the -ä form this unit uses for subjects (አልባበ, ሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ), and ንጉሦሙ ‘their king’ then agrees with them. The other reading takes ሕገ as a construct, ‘the law of the sons of the host of Israel’, with the clergy as subject (?). ንጉሦሙ ዳዊት ‘their king David’: Menelik under his regnal name. ደብተራ ስምዕ ‘tent-of testimony’ is the tabernacle that houses the Ark. ተሐደሰት ‘was renewed’ (T-stem, 3fs, agreeing with መንግሥት); በርሀ ‘shone’ takes the plural አልባበ (አልባብ, plural of ልብ ‘heart’) as subject, ‘hearts shone’. በርእየ ጽዮን ‘at the seeing-of Zion’ (infinitive in construct); ታቦተ ሕጉ ‘ark-of his law’ is in apposition. ወገደፉ ‘and they cast away’ (ገደፈ); ሕዝበ ኢትዮጵያ ‘people-of Ethiopia’ is the subject in the -ä form. ለዘ ፡ ገብሮሙ is printed as two words (ለዘ ‘to him who’); ገብሮሙ ‘made them’ (ገብረ + -ሙ). This is one long unit of 39 words, kept whole as it is one sentence.

sentences.t: ኀደጉ ፡ ምግባራቲሆሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ወርትዐ ፡ ዘያፈቅር ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: They-abandoned deeds-their men-of Ethiopia and-loved righteousness and-uprightness which-loves God ;
sentences.i: The men of Ethiopia abandoned their deeds and loved the righteousness and uprightness that God loves;
sentences.n: This and the next four units open with the same verb: ኀደጉ ‘they abandoned’ (ኀደገ, 3mp perfect), and ወአፍቀሩ ‘and they loved’ (አፍቀረ). Each pairs a vice given up with a virtue taken up, a catalogue pattern. ምግባራቲሆሙ ‘their deeds’ (ምግባር, plural ምግባራት, + -ሆሙ); ሰብአ ኢትዮጵያ ‘men-of Ethiopia’. ጽድቀ ወርትዐ ‘righteousness and uprightness’, both accusative. ዘያፈቅር እግዚኣብሔር ‘which God loves’.

sentences.t: ኀደጉ ፡ ዝሙቶሙ ፡ ዘትካት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ንጽሐ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡ ዘርእዮተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፤
sentences.l: They-abandoned fornication-their of-before (?) and-loved purity amid array of-vision-of Zion heavenly ;
sentences.i: They abandoned their former fornication (?) and loved purity in the array of the vision of heavenly Zion (?);
sentences.n: ዝሙቶሙ ‘their fornication’. ዘትካት I cannot identify securely: ዘ- ‘of’ with ትካት, which ch. 30 reads ‘of establishment, the established’ (?) and ch. 64–65 (ከመ ዘትካት) ‘as before, as formerly’; the latter suits a fornication once practised, so ‘former’ (?). ንጽሐ ‘purity’ (accusative). በውስተ ትዕይንት ዘርእዮተ ጽዮን ሰማያዊት: ትዕይንት ‘host, array’ (as in the published parts, ?) and ዘርእዮተ ‘of the vision-of’ (ርእዮት ‘sight, vision’ in construct); the phrase means something like ‘in the presence of the sight of heavenly Zion’ (?).

sentences.t: ኀደጉ ፡ ማሪተ ፡ ወሰገለ ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ንስሓ ፡ ወአንብዐ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: They-abandoned [maritä] (?) and-sorcery (?) and-loved repentance and-tears for-God ;
sentences.i: They abandoned ማሪተ (?) and sorcery (?), and loved repentance and tears before God;
sentences.n: ማሪተ I cannot identify (?); the same word (ማሪት) stands after ሐቲተ in the list of hated things in ch. 60b. ሰገለ is ሰገል ‘sorcery, divination’ (?), as in chs. 60b and 61. Both are objects of ኀደጉ and stand against ንስሓ ‘repentance’ and አንብዐ ‘tears’ (አንብዕ, plural of እንባዕ ‘tear’, accusative). ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘for God, before God’.

sentences.t: ኀደጉ ፡ ተጠይሮ ፡ ወአጣዕዎ ፡ ወገብኡ ፡ ለሰሚዕ ፡ ወለሠዊዕ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: They-abandoned [täṭäyro] (?) and-idolatry (?) and-returned to-hearing and-to-sacrificing for-God ;
sentences.i: They abandoned ተጠይሮ (?) and idol-worship (?), and turned back to hearing and to sacrificing to God;
sentences.n: ተጠይሮ I cannot identify (?): ch. 27 joins it with bowing to idols and ch. 60b lists it first among what God hates. አጣዕዎ is read ‘idolatry’ (?), from ጣዖት ‘idol’, as in ch. 60b, where the same two words stand together. ወገብኡ ‘and they returned’ (ገብአ), with ለሰሚዕ ወለሠዊዕ ‘to hearing and to sacrificing’: ለ- plus the infinitives of ሰምዐ and ሠውዐ; sacrifice to God against idolatry suits the reading.

sentences.t: ኀደጉ ፡ ተውኔተ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ዘአጋንንት ፡ ወአፍቀሩ ፡ ተቀንዮ ፡ ወሰብሖ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፨
sentences.l: They-abandoned revelry-of gods of-demons and-loved service and-praise for-God ፨
sentences.i: They abandoned the revels of the gods of demons and loved service and praise of God.
sentences.n: ተውኔተ አማልክት ዘአጋንንት ‘play-of gods of-demons’: ተውኔት ‘revelry’ (as in ch. 62–63, ?) is in construct before አማልክት ‘gods’, which ዘ- ‘of’ links to አጋንንት ‘demons’, so ‘the pagan festivals’ (?). ተቀንዮ ‘service, worship’ and ሰብሖ ‘praise’ are infinitives used as nouns (ተቀንየ, ሰብሐ). The ፨ closes the list of conversions.

sentences.t: ኀስራ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወከብራ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: They-were-diminished daughters-of Jerusalem and-were-honoured daughters-of Ethiopia ;
sentences.i: The daughters of Jerusalem were diminished, and the daughters of Ethiopia were honoured;
sentences.n: A series of paired reversals begins. ኀስራ ‘they (f.) were diminished’ (ኀሠረ ‘lack, be reduced’) and ከብራ ‘they (f.) were honoured’ (ከብረ) are 3fp perfects, with fem. plural አዋልደ (ወለት, plural አዋልድ) as subject in the -ä form. The subjects ‘daughters’ are the cities and peoples; compare ‘daughter of Zion’ in the Psalms and Prophets.

sentences.t: ተከዘት ፡ ወለተ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወተፈሥሐት ፡ ወለተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: Grieved daughter-of Judah and-rejoiced daughter-of Ethiopia ;
sentences.i: The daughter of Judah grieved, and the daughter of Ethiopia rejoiced;
sentences.n: ተከዘት ‘she grieved’ (T-stem of ከዘ), ተፈሥሐት ‘she rejoiced’ (ተፈሥሐ), 3fs. ወለተ ‘daughter-of’ is the construct (singular, collective ‘the daughter’); ይሁዳ Judah.

sentences.t: ተፈሥሐ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወተከዛ ፡ አድባረ ፡ ሊባኖስ ።
sentences.l: Rejoiced mountains-of Ethiopia and-grieved mountains-of Lebanon .
sentences.i: The mountains of Ethiopia rejoiced, and the mountains of Lebanon grieved.
sentences.n: ተፈሥሐ is 3ms (the plural አድባር ‘mountains’ taking a masculine singular verb, ?), while ተከዛ, with the ending -ኣ, looks like a 3fp agreeing with the feminine plural (?). አድባረ ‘mountains-of’ is construct; ሊባኖስ is Lebanon.

sentences.t: በጣዖት ፡ ወግልፈዋት ፡ ተኀርዩ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወተመነኑ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: In-idol and-carved-images (?) were-chosen (?) people-of Ethiopia and-were-despised people-of Israel ;
sentences.i: Amid idols and carved images (?), the people of Ethiopia were chosen (?), and the people of Israel were despised;
sentences.n: በጣዖት ወግልፈዋት: ጣዖት ‘idol’ and ግልፈዋት ‘carved images’ (?; as ግልፈ in ch. 13–16, with a plural in -ዋት). I take በ- as ‘amid, in the midst of’ (?), so the Ethiopians were chosen while still idolatrous; ‘because of’ would suit Israel’s fall better, but the phrase stands before the Ethiopian verb. ተኀርዩ is read as the passive of ኀረየ ‘choose’ (‘were chosen’, ?), the opposite of ተመነኑ ‘were despised’ (3mp of ተመነነ, as in ch. 60a), which fits the next unit’s ‘cast-off people’. The sense is the book’s claim that Ethiopia is chosen though once idolatrous, Israel despised though once chosen.

sentences.t: ተመነና ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወከብራ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: Were-despised daughters-of Zion and-were-honoured daughters-of Ethiopia ;
sentences.i: The daughters of Zion were despised, and the daughters of Ethiopia were honoured;
sentences.n: ተመነና ‘they (f.) were despised’ (3fp of ተመነነ, as in ch. 60a). The earlier pair is repeated with Zion in place of Jerusalem.

sentences.t: ኀስሩ ፡ አእሩገ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወከብሩ ፡ አእሩገ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተወክፎሙ ፡ ለግዲፋን ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወመነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘተንሥአት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወመጽአት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: They-were-diminished old-men-of Israel and-were-honoured old-men-of Ethiopia for God received-them the-cast-off people and-despised-them Israel on-account-of that-rose Zion from-them and-came into land-of Ethiopia ;
sentences.i: The elders of Israel were diminished, and the elders of Ethiopia were honoured; for God received the people who had been cast off and despised Israel, because Zion rose up from them and came into the land of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: ኀስሩ ‘they were diminished’, ከብሩ ‘they were honoured’ (3mp). አእሩገ ‘old men’ is the plural of አረጋዊ (as in the published ch. 70) in the construct. እስመ ‘for’. ተወክፎሙ ‘he received them’ (ተወክፈ + -ሙ); ለግዲፋን ሕዝብ ‘to the cast-off people’ (ግዲፍ ‘cast away’, plural ግዲፋን; ለ- marks the object and repeats -ሙ). ወመነኖሙ ለእስራኤል ‘and he despised them, Israel’ (መነነ, as ተመነነ in ch. 60a) (the same pattern). በእንተ ዘ- ‘on account of the fact that’; ዘተንሥአት ጽዮን ‘that Zion rose’ (ተንሥአት, 3fs: Zion/the Ark is feminine); እምኔሆሙ ‘from them’; ወመጽአት ‘and she came’.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሠምረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ተኀድር ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ማኅደራ ፡ ወኀበሰ ፡ ኢሠምረ ፡ ኢተኀድር ፤
sentences.l: For where was-pleased God dwells Zion her-dwelling and-where-indeed not-was-pleased not-dwells ;
sentences.i: For where God is pleased, there Zion dwells in her dwelling; but where he is not pleased, she does not dwell;
sentences.n: ኀበ ‘where’ introduces both conditions; ሠምረ ‘he was pleased’ (perfect, but with present sense in a general statement). ተኀድር ‘she dwells’ (3fs imperfect of ኀደረ) with ማኅደራ ‘her dwelling’ (a cognate noun, ማኅደር + -ኣ, the suffix after a consonant). ወኀበሰ ‘and where, as for…’ (-ሰ the contrast). ኢሠምረ ‘he was not pleased’; ኢተኀድር ‘she does not dwell’.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ ኬንያሃ ፡ ገባሪሃ ፡ ወሐናጺሃ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኄር ፡ በውስተ ፡ ጽርሐ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ለማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ወልዲ ፡ ወመንፈሱ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ አሜን ፨
sentences.l: For himself her-fashioner (?) her-maker and-her-builder God good in-midst-of hall-of sanctuary-his for-dwelling-of glory-his with son-his and-spirit-his holy until for-world-of world Amen ፨
sentences.i: For he himself, God the Good, is her fashioner (?), her maker and her builder, in the hall of his sanctuary, as the dwelling of his glory, with his Son and his Holy Spirit, for ever and ever. Amen.
sentences.n: ለሊሁ ‘he himself’. ኬንያሃ ‘her fashioner’ (?), as in ch. 1 (ወኬንያሃ, with the same ገባሪሃ ‘her maker’); chs. 13–20 take ኬንያ as ‘craftsman’ (?), so the agent noun stays uncertain. ገባሪሃ ‘her maker’ and ሐናጺሃ ‘her builder’ (agent nouns with -ሃ ‘her’, the Ark/Zion). ኄር ‘good’ is an adjective for God. ጽርሐ ‘hall, court-of’ (construct, before መቅደሱ ‘his sanctuary’). ለማኅደረ ስብሐቲሁ ‘for the dwelling-of his glory’. ምስለ ወልዲ: the printed ወልዲ is read as ወልዱ ‘his son’ (the -ዲ for -ዱ also in unit 23, ?); the invocation of Father, Son and Holy Spirit is the Christian trinitarian doxology, ending in አሜን. The ፨ closes the section.

sentences.t: ወወሀበት ፡ ንግሥተ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ መከዳ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ለወልዳ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-gave queen-of Ethiopia Makeda kingdom to-her-son David son-of Solomon king-of Israel ;
sentences.i: And Makeda, queen of Ethiopia, gave the kingdom to her son David, son of Solomon, king of Israel;
sentences.n: ወወሀበት ‘and she gave’ (3fs perfect of ወሀበ). ንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ‘queen-of Ethiopia’ and the name መከዳ (printed so here; ማክዳ, መክዳ in other parts) are the subject, in apposition. ለወልዳ ‘to her son’. ዳዊት is Menelik’s throne name (chs. 38–39, 53). ወልደ ሰሎሞን ‘son-of Solomon’ and ንጉሠ እስራኤል ‘king-of Israel’ are constructs; the second describes Solomon.

sentences.t: ወትቤሎ ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ወሀብኩከ ፡ ወአንገሥኩ ፡ ዘእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አንገሠ ፡ ወኀረይኩ ፡ ዘእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀረየ ፡ ቀዋሚሃ ፡ ለደብተራሁ ፡ ወሠመርኩ ፡ ዘእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሠምረ ፡ ላእከ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳኑ ፡ ወሕጉ ፡ ወአዕበይኩ ፡ ዘእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አዕበየ ፡ መጋቤ ፡ ለአቤራቲሁ ፡ ወአክበርኩ ፡ ዘእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አክበረ ፡ ወሃቤ ፡ ሲሳይ ፡ ለእጓለ ፡ ማውታ ፨
sentences.l: And-she-said-to-him take I-have-given-you and-I-made-king whom God made-king and-I-chose whom God chose attendant-her for-tent-his and-I-approved whom God approved servant-of ark-of covenant-his and-law-his and-I-magnified whom God magnified steward for-[ʾäberat]-his and-I-honoured whom God honoured giver-of food for-orphan ፨
sentences.i: And she said to him: Take it; I have given it to you. I have made king the one whom God made king; I have chosen the one whom God chose, as an attendant at his Tent; I have approved the one whom God approved, a servant of the Ark of his covenant and his law; I have magnified the one whom God magnified, a steward for his needy (?); and I have honoured the one whom God honoured, a giver of food to the orphan.
sentences.n: ንሣእ ‘take!’ (imperative of ነሥአ); ወሀብኩከ ‘I have given you’ (1cs perfect + -ከ). Then five 1cs perfects in -ኩ (አንገሥኩ, ኀረይኩ, ሠመርኩ, አዕበይኩ, አክበርኩ), each followed by ዘእግዚኣብሔር + the same verb in the 3ms (አንገሠ, ኀረየ, ሠምረ, አዕበየ, አክበረ): ዘ- ‘the one whom’, and the verb of her act is matched by God’s. The pattern is deliberate; the five verbs are the causatives አንገሠ, አዕበየ, አክበረ and the simple ኀረየ, ሠምረ. ቀዋሚሃ ለደብተራሁ ‘attendant at his tent’, as in ch. 25–26 (ቀዋሚ ‘one who stands, serves’; the -ሃ anticipates the feminine ደብተራ, and ለደብተራሁ names the owner), here a predicate accusative. ላእከ ታቦተ ኪዳኑ ወሕጉ ‘servant-of the ark-of his covenant and his law’. መጋቤ ‘steward-of / distributor’; ለአቤራቲሁ I cannot identify (?), perhaps ‘his needy ones’ from the parallel with orphans. ወሃቤ ሲሳይ ‘giver-of food’ (ወሃቢ ‘giver’ in construct; the ወ belongs to the word, as in ወወሃቤ, ch. 24, and not ‘and’). እጓለ ማውታ ‘child-of the dead’ = orphan. The ፨ ends the speech she gives.

sentences.t: ወተንሥአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወቀነተ ፡ ዘይትዐጸፍ ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ለእሙ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ንግሥትሰ ፡ አንቲ ፡ እግዝእትየ ፡ ወአነ ፡ እትለአክ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘአዘዝክኒ ፡ እመሂ ፡ ለሞት ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ ለሕይወት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈነውክኒ ፡ እትፌነው ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ለአክኒ ፡ እትለአክ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘአዘዝክኒ ፡ እገብር ፤
sentences.l: And-rose the-king and-girded what he-wraps-himself-in (?) and-bowed to-his-mother and-said-to-her queen-indeed you my-lady and-I I-am-sent in-where all that you-commanded-me whether to-death and-whether to-life where you-sent-me I-am-sent and-where you-dispatched-me I-serve and-all that you-commanded-me I-do ;
sentences.i: The king rose, girded up his mantle (?), bowed to his mother, and said to her: You are queen, my lady, and I will be sent wherever you command me, whether to death or to life. Where you send me I shall be sent, and where you dispatch me I shall serve; and everything you command me, I will do;
sentences.n: ወተንሥአ ንጉሥ ‘and the king rose’ (verb first). ወቀነተ ዘይትዐጸፍ: ቀነተ ‘he girded’ (cf. መቀነት ‘girdle’, ch. 24) and ዘይትዐጸፍ ‘that which he wraps himself in’ (relative + T-stem imperfect of ዐጸፈ), so ‘he girded up his mantle’ (?), a gesture of readiness and respect; the sense is a guess. ሰገደ ለእሙ ‘he bowed to his mother’ (እም + -ሁ, written እሙ). ወይቤላ ‘and he said to her’. ንግሥትሰ አንቲ ‘as for queen, you (are)’ (-ሰ contrast). እግዝእትየ ‘my lady’. እትለአክ ‘I am sent’ (1cs imperfect of ተለአከ; ‘serve’ is also possible, so the second occurrence is given as ‘serve’), after በኀበ ኵሉ ዘአዘዝክኒ ‘to where all that you commanded me’ and ዘአዘዝክኒ ‘what you commanded me’ (2fs perfect + -ኒ). እመሂ … ወእመሂ ‘whether … or’. ኀበ ‘where’; ፈነውክኒ ‘you sent me’ (ፈነወ) with እትፌነው ‘I shall be sent’ (T-stem, passive); ለአክኒ ‘you sent me’ (ለአከ) with እትለአክ ‘I shall serve’. እገብር ‘I do’. The speaker is David–Menelik; the speech runs to unit 34.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አንቲ ፡ ርእስ ፡ ወአነ ፡ እግር ፡ ወአንቲ ፡ እግዝእት ፡ ወአነ ፡ ገብር ፡ ለኪ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ይትገበር ፡ በቃልኪ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትዐደው ፡ እምትእዛዝኪ ፡ ወእገብር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘፈቀድኪ ።
sentences.l: For you head and-I foot and-you lady and-I servant to-you and-all is-done by-your-word and-not-is who goes-beyond from-your-command and-I-do all that you-wished .
sentences.i: For you are the head and I am the foot; you are the lady and I am your servant; everything is done at your word, there is no one who goes beyond your command, and I will do all that you wish.
sentences.n: ርእስ ‘head’, እግር ‘foot’: the body image of ruler and subject. አልቦ ዘ- ‘there is none who’. ይትገበር ‘it is done’ (T-stem, passive of ገብረ). ይትዐደው ‘goes beyond, transgresses’ (ተዐደወ). በቃልኪ ‘by your word’ and እምትእዛዝኪ ‘from your command’ take the 2fs suffix -ኪ. ዘፈቀድኪ ‘what you wished’ (ፈቀደ).

sentences.t: ወባሕቱ ፡ ጸልዪ ፡ ላዕሌየ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያድኅነኒ ፡ እመዐቱ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-but pray (f.) for-me that he-save-me from-wrath-his God-of Israel ;
sentences.i: But pray for me, that the God of Israel may save me from his wrath;
sentences.n: ወባሕቱ ‘but’. ጸልዪ ‘pray!’ is the feminine imperative (ጸለየ), addressed to Makeda. ከመ ያድኅነኒ ‘that he save me’ (subjunctive of አድኀነ + -ኒ). እመዐቱ ‘from his wrath’ (እም + መዐት + -ሁ). አምላከ እስራኤል ‘God-of Israel’ (construct).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ይትመዐዕ ፡ ይቤሉነ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኢያርታዕነ ፡ ልበነ ፡ ለገቢረ ፡ ፈቃዲ ፡ ወኢያሠነይነ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ትእዛዙ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ለእ ፡ ግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: For he-will-be-angry they-said-to-us if not we-direct heart-our to-doing will-his and-not we-do-well in-all commands-his for-Zion dwelling-of glory-his of-God ;
sentences.i: For they told us that he will be angry if we do not direct our heart to doing his will, and do not act well in all his commands concerning Zion, the dwelling of God’s glory;
sentences.n: ይቤሉነ ‘they said to us’ (3mp of ይቤ + -ነ) governs the report እስመ ይትመዐዕ ‘that he will be angry’ (T-stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ). ለእመ ‘if’; ኢያርታዕነ ‘we do not make straight’ (the causative አርትዐ ‘direct, set right’, with ልበነ ‘our heart’). ለገቢረ ‘to doing’ (infinitive in construct). ፈቃዲ: the printed form is read as ፈቃዱ ‘his will’ (?). ወኢያሠነይነ ‘and we do not do well’ (አሠነየ). ለእ ፡ ግዚኣብሔር is a source slip, a word split by a wordspace, printed as in the edition; read ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘of/for God’. ማኅደረ ስብሐቲሁ ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘dwelling-of his glory, God’s’ (anticipatory suffix, then ለ- naming the owner) = ‘the dwelling of God’s glory’, in apposition to ጽዮን.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ መልአከ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ዘመገበነ ፡ ወአብጽሐነ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ወኢይትፈለጥ ፡ ወኢይትአተት ፡ እምኔነ ።
sentences.l: For angel-of power-his with-us who nourished-us (?) and-brought-us here and-not is-parted and-not is-withdrawn from-us .
sentences.i: for the angel of his power is with us, who has fed us (?) and brought us here, and he is not parted or withdrawn from us.
sentences.n: መልአከ ኀይሉ ‘angel-of his power’ (construct). ዘመገበነ ‘who fed us’ (መገበ ‘feed, nourish’ + -ነ; the sense is uncertain, ?). ወአብጽሐነ ‘and brought us’ (causative of በጽሐ, ‘arrive’). ኢይትፈለጥ ‘he is not separated’ (T-stem passive of ፈለጠ) and ኢይትአተት ‘he is not withdrawn’ (a T-stem of አተተ, ?). The angel is the Ark’s escort in the journey.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ስምዒ ፡ ኦእግዝእትየ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አሠነይነ ፡ ወገበርነ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ አነ ፡ ወእለ ፡ እምድኅሬየ ፡ ይነብር ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ወየዐቅበነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ወእምእደ ፡ ፀርነ ፤
sentences.l: And-now hear (f.) O-my-lady if we-do-well and-do will-his I and-those after-me will-dwell God with-us and-will-keep-us from-all evil and-from-hand-of enemy-our ;
sentences.i: And now, hear, my lady: if we do well and do his will, I and those who come after me, God will dwell with us and keep us from all evil and from the hand of our enemy;
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ ‘and now’ (-ኒ ‘indeed’). ስምዒ ‘hear!’ (fem. imperative of ሰምዐ). ኦእግዝእትየ ‘O my lady’ (ኦ the vocative, joined to the noun). ለእመ ‘if’, with perfects አሠነይነ, ገበርነ (1cp). እለ እምድኅሬየ ‘those who are after me’. ይነብር ‘he will dwell’ (imperfect used as a future) and ወየዐቅበነ ‘and he will keep us’ (ዐቀበ + -ነ). እምነ ኵሉ እኩይ ‘from all evil’ (እምነ for እም). እምእደ ፀርነ ‘from the hand-of our enemy’ (እደ is construct of እድ).

sentences.t: ወእመሰ ፡ ኢያርታዕነ ፡ ልበነ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ይትመዐዐነ ፡ ወይመይጥ ፡ ገጾ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወይቀሥፈነ ፡ ወይትሐበለዩነ ፡ ጸላእትነ ፡ ወይመጽአነ ፡ ፍርሀት ፡ ወረዓድ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ኢተሐዘብነ ፡ ወይትነሥኡ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወይጸብዑነ ፡ አጽባአ ፡ ወያጠፍኡነ ።
sentences.l: And-if-but not-we-direct heart-our to-him he-will-be-angry-with-us and-turn face-his from-us and-scourge-us and-plot-against-us enemies-our and-come-on-us fear and-trembling from-where not we-expected and-rise against-us and-fight-us battles and-destroy-us .
sentences.i: But if we do not direct our heart to him, he will be angry with us, turn his face away from us, and scourge us; our enemies will plot against us (?), fear and trembling will come upon us from where we did not expect it, and they will rise against us, wage war on us, and destroy us.
sentences.n: ወእመሰ ‘but if’. ይትመዐዐነ ‘he will be angry with us’ (T-stem, root m-ʿ-ʿ, + -ነ). ወይመይጥ ገጾ ‘and he will turn his face’ (ይመይጥ, G imperfect of መይጠ ‘turn’, not the causative; ‘turn the face away’ is the Hebrew-style idiom of God’s withdrawal). ወይቀሥፈነ ‘and he will scourge us’ (ቀሠፈ). ይትሐበለዩነ I read as ‘they will plot against us’ (a T-stem of ሐበለ, ?). ጸላእትነ ‘our enemies’. ወይመጽአነ ‘and there will come on us’ (መጽአ with the object suffix). ፍርሀት ወረዓድ ‘fear and trembling’. እምኀበ ኢተሐዘብነ ‘from where we did not expect’ (ተሐዘበ ‘think, expect’). ይጸብዑነ አጽባአ ‘they will fight us fights’, a cognate accusative (ጸብአ ‘war’); ያጠፍኡነ ‘they will destroy us’. Fear of the enemy is the punishment for failing in the Ark’s service.

sentences.t: ወለእመሰ ፡ ገበርነ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአሠነይነ ፡ ግብራ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ንከውን ፡ ኄራን ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይክል ፡ አሕሥሞ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ በደብረ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ማኅደሩ ፡ ምስሌነ ።
sentences.l: And-if-but we-do will-of God and-do-well her-service for-Zion we-shall-be good and-not-is who is-able to-harm (?) against-us on-mountain-of sanctuary-his while is-present dwelling-his with-us .
sentences.i: But if we do the will of God and do Zion’s service well, we shall be good, and there will be no one who can do us harm (?) on the mountain of his sanctuary while his dwelling is with us.
sentences.n: ወለእመሰ ‘but if’, the opposite case. ፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር ‘will-of God’; ግብራ ለጽዮን ‘her service, Zion’s’ (ግብር + -ኣ, doubled by ለ-). ንከውን ኄራን ‘we shall be good’ (ኄራን, plural of ኄር ‘good, kind’). አልቦ ዘይክል ‘there is none who can’ and አሕሥሞ, a form I cannot parse securely (?), perhaps from አሕሠመ ‘harm’ (the root also behind አሕሠምኪ in ch. 64–65, where the sense is not settled either). ደብረ መቅደሱ ‘the mountain-of his sanctuary’ (Zion). እንዘ ሀለወት ማኅደሩ ‘while his dwelling is (3fs) present’.

sentences.t: ወነዋ ፡ ዘአምጻእነ ፡ ጽሑፍ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕገ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ ወትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዘነገረነ ፡ ሰዶቅ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ካህናት ፡ አመ ፡ ይቀብአኒ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ መንግሥት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ቀርነ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ ዕፍረት ፡ ዘክህነት ፡ ወዘመንግሥት ፤
sentences.l: And-behold what we-brought written with-us all law-of kingdom and-command-of God which told-us Zadok chief-of priests when he-anointed-me anointing-of kingdom in-house-of sanctuary-his of-God while in hand-his horn-of oil-of ointment of-priesthood and-of-kingdom ;
sentences.i: And behold, we have brought with us, written down, the whole law of the kingdom and the command of God which Zadok the high priest declared to us when he anointed me with the anointing of kingship in the house of God’s sanctuary, while in his hand was the horn of ointment oil, for priesthood and for kingship;
sentences.n: ወነዋ ‘and behold’. ዘአምጻእነ ጽሑፍ ‘what we brought, written’. ሕገ መንግሥት ‘law-of kingdom’ and ትእዛዘ እግዚኣብሔር ‘command-of God’ are constructs; ዘነገረነ ‘which told us’ (ነገረ + -ነ). ሰዶቅ is Zadok, who anointed Solomon (1 Kings 1:39); here he anoints David–Menelik in Jerusalem (chs. 38–40). አመ ‘when’. ይቀብአኒ ‘he anointed me’ (ቀብአ + -ኒ); ቅብአ መንግሥት ‘anointing-of kingdom’. ለእግዚኣብሔር follows ቤተ መቅደሱ as a doubling of the possessor (the house pattern). እንዘ ውስተ እዴሁ ‘while in his hand’ (እድ + -ሁ). ቀርነ ቅብአ ዕፍረት ‘horn-of anointing oil’ (ዕፍረት ‘ointment, spice’), ዘክህነት ወዘመንግሥት ‘of priesthood and of kingdom’.

sentences.t: ወገብሩ ፡ ለነ ፡ ዘበሕጉ ፡ ወተቀ ፡ ባእነ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ለክህነት ፡ ወአነ ፡ ለመንግሥት ፡ ወአልምያስ ፡ አፈ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ዐቃቤ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ዐቃቢሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወእዘኒሁ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ ጽድቅ ።
sentences.l: And-they-did for-us what by-law-his and-we-were-anointed (?) Azariah for-priesthood and-I for-kingdom and-Almeyas mouth-of God keeper-of law who is keeper-her of-Zion and-ears-his of-king in-all way-of righteousness .
sentences.i: They did for us what is according to his law, and we were anointed (?), Azariah for the priesthood and I for the kingship, and Almeyas as the mouth of God, the keeper of the law, who is Zion’s guardian and the ears of the king in every path of righteousness.
sentences.n: ወገብሩ ለነ ዘበሕጉ ‘and they did for us what is by his law’ (ዘ- + በ- + ሕግ + -ሁ). ተቀ ፡ ባእነ is printed as two words, a source slip: joined it is ተቀባእነ, which I read as ተቀብአነ ‘we were anointed’ (T-stem of ቀብአ, 1cp, ?; the printed ā is not in that form). The reading suits unit 28, where the horn is ‘for priesthood and for kingdom’. አዛርያስ ለክህነት ‘Azariah for priesthood’, ወአነ ለመንግሥት ‘and I for kingdom’. አልምያስ is probably the same man as ኤልምያስ of unit 4 and ch. 45 (?); no verb is repeated for him, so ‘as’ is supplied in the English. አፈ እግዚኣብሔር ‘mouth-of God’ and ዐቃቤ ሕግ ‘keeper-of law’ are construct chains; ዘውእቱ ዐቃቢሃ ለጽዮን ‘who is her keeper, Zion’s’ (-ሃ doubled by ለ-). እዘኒሁ ለንጉሥ ‘his ears, the king’s’ (the stem እዘኒ- is unexplained, perhaps for አእዛኒሁ (?)), the king’s hearer. ፍኖተ ጽድቅ ‘way-of righteousness’ (cf. Psalm 23:3).

sentences.t: ወአዘዙኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘእገብር ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ በምክሮሙ ፡ ወአቀሙነ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወቅድመ ፡ ሊቃውንተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ይሰምዕ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይኤዝዘነ ፡ ሰዶቅ ፡ ካህን ።
sentences.l: And-they-commanded-me that not-is what I-do except by-counsel-their and-they-stood-us before king and-before chiefs-of Israel and-all people hear while he-commanded-us Zadok priest .
sentences.i: And they charged me that I should do nothing except on their counsel, and they set us before the king and the chiefs of Israel, while all the people listened as Zadok the priest commanded us.
sentences.n: ወአዘዙኒ ‘and they commanded me’ (አዘዘ + -ኒ). ከመ አልቦ ዘእገብር ‘that there be nothing which I do’. ዘእንበለ በምክሮሙ ‘except by their counsel’ (ምክር + -ሙ). ወአቀሙነ ‘and they set us’ (አቀመ + -ነ). ቅድመ ‘before’ (construct); ሊቃውንተ እስራኤል ‘chiefs-of Israel’ (construct plural). ሕዝብ ይሰምዕ ‘the people hear’; እንዘ ይኤዝዘነ ‘while he was commanding us’ (imperfect after እንዘ). The king is Solomon.

sentences.t: ወተነፍኀ ፡ ኢዮብልዮስ ፡ ወኣርጋኖን ፡ ወቃለ ፡ ዕንዚራቲሆሙ ፡ ወብዕዛቲሆሙ ፡ ወድምፀ ፡ ጽራኃቲሆሙ ፡ ዘተገብረ ፡ አሜሃ ፡ በአናቅጺሃ ፡ ለኢየሩሳሌም ።
sentences.l: And-were-blown jubilee (?) and-organ (?) and-voice-of harps-their and-ብዕዛ (?)-their and-sound-of cries-their (?) which was-done then at-gates-her of-Jerusalem .
sentences.i: And the jubilee-horn (?) and the organ (?) were blown, and the voice of their harps and their ብዕዛ (?) and the sound of their cries (?), which was done then at the gates of Jerusalem.
sentences.n: ተነፍኀ ‘it was blown’ (T-stem passive of ነፍሐ), singular though the subjects are several. ኢዮብልዮስ is a loan, Greek-Latin ‘jubilee’ (from Hebrew yôbēl, the ram’s horn); ኣርጋኖን is Greek ὄργανον ‘instrument, organ’ (so ‘pipe’, ?). ቃለ ‘voice-of’, ድምፀ ‘sound-of’ (constructs). ዕንዚራቲሆሙ ‘their harps’ (as in the published parts, though the type is uncertain, ?). ብዕዛቲሆሙ (a word left uncertain in chs. 38–39 and 55–56, ?) and ጽራኃቲሆሙ ‘their cries’ (?; ጽራኅ ‘cry’, as in ch. 49–50, plural + -ሆሙ; an instrument is the other possibility). ዘተገብረ ‘which was done’. አሜሃ ‘then’. በአናቅጺሃ ለኢየሩሳሌም ‘at its gates, Jerusalem’s’ (አናቅጽ plural of አንቀጽ ‘gate’). This is a reminder of the anointing in ch. 38–40.

sentences.t: ምንተ ፡ እነግረክሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ሀለውክሙ ፡ ዝየ ፤
sentences.l: What I-shall-tell-you to-those who-are you-here ;
sentences.i: What shall I tell you who are here?
sentences.n: ምንተ ‘what’ (ምንት in the accusative). እነግረክሙ ‘I shall tell you’ (2mp suffix). ለእለ ሀለውክሙ ዝየ ‘to those who are present here’, a plural address. The speaker (David–Menelik) turns from his mother to the whole assembly, or the narrator speaks for him (?).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ መሰለነ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘታድለቀልቅ ፡ እስከ ፡ መሠረታቲሃ ፡ ወሰማይኒ ፡ ዘያንጐደጒድ ፡ በመልዕልቴነ ፤
sentences.l: For it-seemed-to-us earth that-it-shook until foundations-her and-heaven-also that-thundered above-us ;
sentences.i: For it seemed to us that the earth shook to its foundations and that the heaven thundered above us;
sentences.n: መሰለነ ‘it seemed to us’ (መሰለ ‘resemble, seem’ + -ነ). ዘታድለቀልቅ ‘that it shook’ (ዘ- introduces the thing seen; ታድለቀልቅ is a quadriliteral 3fs, ምድር being feminine) and ዘያንጐደጒድ ‘that it thundered’ (quadriliteral, 3ms). እስከ መሠረታቲሃ ‘until its foundations’ (መሠረት, plural መሠረታት + -ሃ). ሰማይኒ ‘heaven also’ (-ኒ). በመልዕልቴነ ‘above us’ (a preposition with the suffix). The text does not say what caused the shaking and thunder; it follows the blast of the trumpets at Jerusalem (unit 31).

sentences.t: ወልብኒ ፡ ትርዕድ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ብረኪሃ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-heart-also trembled with knees-her (?) ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.i: And the heart, too, trembled along with its knees (?).
sentences.n: ወልብኒ ‘and the heart also’ (-ኒ). ትርዕድ ‘it trembles’ (3fs imperfect of ርዕደ, so ልብ is treated as feminine here, ?). ምስለ ብረኪሃ ‘with her knees’ (ብረክ ‘knee’, as in ch. 55–56 ለብረክየ ‘to my knees’, + -ሃ ‘her’; the plural form is not as expected, and the ‘her’ has no clear antecedent, ?). The run of ፨ marks the end of the chapter and the part.
